senses.gloss: m. (אור, cmp. חור) white substance, undyed wool or cotton.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 11b">Sabb. 11ᵇ</cite>; (Tosef. ib. I, 8 missing). Ib. 79ᵃ <he>דוגמא לא׳</he> a sample color for the wool (given to the dyer).—Pl. <he>אִירִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:7">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite>, the remnants of wool in the hands of the dyer. [R. Hanan. reads <cite ref="A01156"><he>אִידָּא</he></cite> q. v.] [<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 4</cite> <he>אִירָה</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:1">Kel. XXI, 1</cite> <cite ref="P00678"><he>עִירָה</he></cite>.]
